newsitem.title: USA: LSI completes Grady McCauley acquisition.
newsitem.headline: LSI completes Grady McCauley acquisition.

text.p: LSI Industries Inc said Tuesday it completed its acquisition of private Grady McCauley Inc for $11.5 million in cash and $6 million in stock.
When the company announced the acquisition May 19, it said it would pay about $6 million in cash and $6 million in stock, or 475,000 common shares.
"We also ended up buying (Grady's) building and the land for $5.2 million (in cash), which we will refinance" explained LSI president Bob Ready.
Ready added Grady, a manufacturer of custom graphics, had about $15.5 million in annual sales and would contribute to LSI's earnings in its fiscal year starting July 1.

LSI posted a $6.1 million profit on $105.3 million in revenues for the nine months ended March 31, compared with a $4.3 million profit on $114.9 million in revenues the year before. The company's stock closed at 14 Tuesday, up 1/2.
